as_told.title: Foo fighters interfering with Allied fighter flight paths

plain: From 1942 to 1945, Allied and Axis fighter pilots are said to have seen what looked like controlled balls of lightning, nicknamed foo fighters, followed by the "ghost rockets" reported over Sweden in 1946. Michels tells it himself several times, bringing in names like James Doolittle and Eisenhower, though he places the sightings differently: once among pilots on both sides, once over Germany, and once in Bavaria, southern Germany, where he says they got in the way of Allied flight paths. If true, unknown objects were already shadowing warplanes before anyone spoke of flying saucers.
